name: 2017 Diversity Report K-8 - Special Programs
description: This dataset contains school-level information on K-8 special programs in New York City public schools, drawn from a 2017 diversity report covering the 2016-17 school year. Each row represents a school and special program combination, with programs limited to Dual Language and Gifted and Talented. For each row, the data breaks down enrollment by grade (kindergarten through eighth grade), gender, race and ethnicity, and English language learner home languages such as Spanish, Chinese, Bengali, Arabic, Haitian Creole, French, Russian, Korean, and Urdu. It also includes English language arts and math test results by performance level, with counts and percentages of students scoring at each level and at levels 3 and 4 combined. Rows are further categorized by student group, including all students, those receiving free or reduced-price lunch, English language learners, students in temporary housing, and students attending school outside their district of residence. Values are stored as text and include codes such as "s"
